title: Why Bilingual Brains Switch Languages Without Asking
author: Laura Bilbao Broch MSc
summary: Bilingual people often find themselves speaking in one language when a word from another shows up unexpectedly mid-sentence. New neuroscience explains what’s going on in the brain, and it isn’s confusion.

# Why Bilingual Brains Switch Languages Without Asking

> Bilingual people often find themselves speaking in one language when a word from another shows up unexpectedly mid-sentence. New neuroscience explains what’s going on in the brain, and it isn’s confusion.
